description: Live check of one source's portal URL: exactly one request (no retry), redirects reported (not followed), HTTP status, response time, and whether that matches the registry's status. A url is never fetched itself: it picks a registry row by host and path, and when no row clearly matches, the rows on that host are listed and nothing is fetched. Never calls key-required or account-gated sources, and reports a bot block rather than working around it.

url.description: A portal URL; matched to its registry row by host

name: check_source
